query:
-- Confirm SHL slot 9 attendee 2 now has Cath
SELECT m.timeSlot, m.attendeeId, m.attendeeNumber, m.status
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName = 'SHL' AND m.timeSlot = 9 AND m.isVisible = 1;

-- Confirm Cath's total meetings
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_meetings, GROUP_CONCAT(s.companyName ORDER BY m.timeSlot SEPARATOR ', ') as sponsors
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId = '452351' AND m.isVisible = 1;
